title: French Publisher Kana's Founder Yves Schlirf Dies
content: French publishing companies Dargaud and Kana announced on September 14 that Kana founder Yves Schlirf died on September 13. Schlirf was also director-general for Dargaud in Belgium, and editorial director at Dargaud Benelux publishing at the time of his death. Schlirf was born in Brussels, Belgium.
